monday.look: monday.com marketing: white or very light background, modular rounded cards (radius 16 to 24), status chips in the four status colours (green done, yellow working on it, coral stuck, purple), board rows with colour cells, playful big headline in dark ink #323338, thin grey body copy. Colour is used in blocks and chips, never as a flat full page. Photos sit inside rounded cards with a soft shadow feel.

apple.look: Apple marketing: extreme restraint. One object (the photo) centred with vast space, a single huge headline in near black #1d1d1f, a short grey #86868b line, pages either white/#f5f5f7 or pure black with white type. No decoration, no chips, no rules. Hierarchy by scale only. Occasionally one blue #0071e3 link-like line.
